COMMON ORDER
Counsel for the Liquidator is represented by Ld. Counsel Mr. S. Sathyanarayanan.
Counsel for R6 is represented by Ld. Counsel Ms. Pratiksha in MA/360/2019.
Counsel for Applicant in IA/352(CHE)/2021 is represented by Ld. Counsel Ms.
Prerna Khatri. Counsel for R9 & R11 in MA/359/2019 is represented by Ld.
Counsel Mr. Manisekar. Mr. M. Palanimuthu from The Regional Provident Fund
Commissioner is present.
Report of the Liquidator with respect to private sale is taken on record. In order
to give approval for private sale as per the report submitted by Counsel for the
Liquidator, let notice be taken to all parties and stakeholders and meeting of the
stakeholders committee be held in which the agenda for effecting private sale be
effected and an application be moved before this Adjudicating Authority for
granting approval.
List the matter on 22.07.2022 for hearing.
